program.name: Morning Joint Flow
program.subject: Yoga flow
program.blurb: A long morning flow that moves every joint from the neck down to the ankles.
program.about: A long morning practice that wakes every joint in order. Neck and shoulders first, then the spine, then hips, knees and ankles, then sun salutations and standing poses that use them all, and a short rest. Two orders alternate. Level II holds every pose longer and Level III brings harder poses.
